'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Joe Orthner DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
